mizan-tepi-university.summary: Mizan-Tepi University is a public university in South West Ethiopia, established in 2006; its homepage reports 17,848 enrolled students. Its colleges and schools offer undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in engineering, medicine and health sciences, business and economics, natural and computational sciences, social sciences and humanities, and computing.

woldia-university.summary: Woldia University is a public university in Woldia, North Wollo. It publishes complete lists of its undergraduate programmes, more than sixty master's programmes and six PhD programmes, across colleges of agriculture, business, education, health, natural sciences and social sciences, an Institute of Technology, the St. Lalibela Institute of Heritage and Tourism Studies, and schools of land administration and law.

st-paul-s-hospital-millennium-medical-co.summary: St. Paul's Hospital Millennium Medical College is a teaching hospital in Addis Ababa that combines specialised healthcare with the education of health professionals and research. It has a School of Medicine, a School of Nursing and a School of Public Health.

wondo-genet-college-of-forestry.summary: Wondo Genet College of Forestry and Natural Resources, established in 1978, is one of the founding colleges of Hawassa University and lies about 35 km south-east of Hawassa. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and PhD programmes in regular and continuing education.

unity-university.summary: Unity University describes itself as the pioneer private higher education institution in Ethiopia; it began as a language school in 1991 and joined the MIDROC Technology Group in 2008. It has campuses in Gerji (Addis Ababa), Adama, Dessie and Burayu, and runs degree and TVET programmes.

st-mary-s-university.summary: St. Mary's University is a private university in Addis Ababa with an undergraduate campus, a School of Graduate Studies, a College of Open Distance Learning and a Faculty of International Programs. It offers degrees in accounting, business, economics, tourism and computer science, and master's programmes in business, informatics, development studies and quality management.
